summary: Iteration 2 testing (Razorpay stubs, Leaflet map + location, AI photo categorization). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases in test_iter2.py PASS. Frontend: all target flows work — recycler marketplace shows market-map with tiles + 'km away' distance labels + match buttons; Purchases pay-menu shows Stripe enabled and Razorpay DISABLED with a razorpay-not-configured note, close hides menu, Stripe redirects to checkout.stripe.com; collector overview shows collector-map with legend 'amber = recycler (1)'; New Listing wizard step1 has working LocationPicker (map click updates picked-coords to real lat,lng and summary), photo-input upload reaches 'Stored'; step2 ai-analyze-button correctly disabled without photo, enabled after upload, ai-result populated (category=pcb, weight=0.5) and publish succeeded; new recycler register flow shows 'Set your facility location', map click + save-facility-location-button emits toast and reveals market-map with distance-sorted lots.

issues: Pre-existing (iter1) React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option>. Still emitted in console; non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: razorpay_routes.py: config endpoint & 503 gates are correct; keys are read at request time via os.environ (good — can be enabled without restart, provided load_dotenv reads updates or supervisor restart happens).
routes.py haversine + with_distance uses (distance is None, distance or 0) sort key — correct null-last behaviour verified in tests.
PUT /me/location validates lat/lng bounds via Pydantic (422 on lat=200) — good.
ai.py falls back to category='mixed' if model returns something not in PRICE_TABLE — good defensive default.
LocationPicker click handler correctly wires useMapEvents; picked-coords updates to 4-decimal string.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and JWT in localStorage rc_token consistently.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — collector@nullset.dev / Collector@123, recycler@nullset.dev / Recycler@123, admin unchanged. Additional TEST_rec_* recycler registered during flow (safe/prefixed).
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed collector listings (near/far lat/lng, no-loc, matched-for-razorpay) and one TEST_rec_* recycler via register flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 backend regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). AI photo test calls Emergent LLM once per pytest run — keep total calls minimal. Note: model returns 'pcb'/'mixed'/etc as valid categories; the allowed set now includes 'mixed' (see test). Frontend Leaflet click needs the actual .leaflet-container element bounding box (map section can be far down the page — do not assume viewport 0,0).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only pre-existing iter1 <option><span> hydration warning remains.
